== Ingredients ==

* 6 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (1450 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Basmati rice|basmati rice]]
* 7 cups (1680 ml) [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
* Salt
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Pandan|pandan]] leaves tied in a knot (optional)
* {{convert|2|in}} of fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] root (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Rinse the rice and set it aside.
#Meanwhile put the coconut milk on the stove, and add the salt.
#Add the rice, pandan leaves, and ginger. Let it [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until the coconut milk evaporates.
#Cover it with lid and let it sit for about 15 minutes until it is well cooked.
